panels.title: AI Gateway

panels.title: 每分鐘請求
panels.description: 使用者 API 金鑰＋內建 AI 功能（近 5 分鐘平均）

panels.title: 平台錯誤率
panels.description: 連不到上游、上游 5xx、串流中斷等（不含呼叫端 4xx 與限流），近 5 分鐘

panels.title: Campus 端（使用者 API 金鑰與內建 AI 功能）
每秒請求（依模型）
panels.description: model 只保留 LiteLLM 認得的模型，其餘歸為 other

panels.title: 結果類別
panels.description: success／client_error（呼叫端 4xx）／rate_limited／unavailable（連不到 LiteLLM）／upstream_error（5xx）／stream_error／cancelled

panels.title: 單次 AI 呼叫延遲（全部／成功）
panels.description: Per logical public request / per individual System AI model call, not per System HTTP workflow. Cancelled calls are excluded from duration; see outcome counters. Non-stream System AI has no TTFT.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, source, model, request_type, stream) (rate(skylab_ai_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skylab-backend"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, source, model, request_type, stream) (rate(skylab_ai_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skylab-backend"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, source, model, request_type, stream) (rate(skylab_ai_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skylab-backend",outcome="success"}[5m])))

panels.title: 首字延遲（串流）
panels.description: Public streaming output only. Headers, empty delta and usage-only events are not first output. No sample means unmeasured, not zero.

panels.description: 模型回報的 usage（input＝提示、output＝生成）

panels.title: 來源
